scene: You step off the gondola onto a rooftop humming with weather machines.
picture: A flat side-view along a wet roofline. Far left, an empty suspended yellow window-cleaner gondola. Standing left of centre is the player in orange jacket and beanie. To his left sits a bubbling cloud tank. Centre stands a groaning pipe with a red valve. Far right, a yellow ladder leads up.
shown: a bubbly cloud swirling inside a brass-ringed glass tank on the left
a large red iron valve bolted to a groaning copper pipe in the centre
a yellow metal ladder bolted to a chimney stack on the far right

variants.scene: Steam puffs around you as cool evening air settles across the city rooftops.
You adjust your brass telescope, still hoping to spot {quest} across the skyline.
The yellow cable gondola creaks behind you near the hissing roof pipes.
